g.text: Graph revision AC - ps01: Melt path: refractory trough x 40..600 (invert z 100, bore 48 high) in a steel channel base; distribution header along x 280 y 246..546 feeding both risers
Graph revision AC - ps01: Graphite bottom-fill risers x2: D28 x 350 from the header up into each insert floor (melt bore class D20); the N5 drain well at x 340 is an OD75 frozen-slug pig tube
Graph revision AC - ps01: N1 DN15 Class 150 flange at the -X face z 160 (OD95 class per AQS-PIP-003) with an OD21.3 spigot reaching the trough head; N5 DN15 flange face z 50 down-facing

Graph revision AC - ps01: Pour station: 12 kg-class ladle (shell OD280 x 240 t25 + D115 x t25 alumina ram lining, relining is a buy item) between two trunnion lug plates bolted under the tilt-arm saddle (2 x M16 T-bolts, fasteners.csv item 1); hand tilt, no actuator
Graph revision AC - ps01: Vent hood plenum 500 x 200 over the pour zone (top plate t6); N6 DN15 Class 150 flanged tap at top z 800 ties to the plant vent header at detail design
Graph revision AC - ps01: Gasket faces per AQS-PIP-003 class practice (AQS-STD-002 section 14); general tolerance ISO 2768-m
